hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for token launch pools. Takes WETH trading fees via beforeSwap/afterSwap deltas using either a time-decaying anti-snipe schedule or a market-cap-based fee curve. Splits fees between protocol, creator, and partner; routes the creator share through a keeper-permissionless flywheel for buyback-and-burn, auto-LP, token reflections, or WETH dividends. Blocks trading until a configured timestamp and lifts launch-window token transfer limits once price crosses a target market cap.
